modules.shared/launcher.mjs: Retain decoded PatchEXE body as patcherText; existing files.patcher normalized metadata remains.
modules.shared/launcher-patch.mjs: Pure raw byte producer and native exit-code policy.
modules.shared/game-patch.mjs: Sequential candidate generator, reused by existing synchronous batch API.
modules.web/launcher-game-patch.mjs: Bound catalog/selection/directory plan and explicit-origin async preparation.

producer.input: own data directoryBytes/patcherBytes/codeTextBytes/addressBytes/portBytes, alreadyPatched:boolean, caseProfile:ascii; actual Uint8Arrays
producer.transform: ASCII/C uppercase of PatchEXE, then all .EXE -> .BAK.EXE replacements
producer.command: directory + backslash + transformedPatchEXE + space + originalPIP + space + originalPPort + NUL; raw/unquoted
producer.packagedSource: original Code text + backslash + original PatchEXE + NUL; relative metadata only
producer.ownership: owned output bytes; no filesystem/process actions
producer.budgets: 4096B each field;32767B NUL-inclusive construction; Code is explicit digits <=14
producer.limits: ASCII/C patcher case only; raw directory bytes can be explicit windows936/UTF8, not actual ACP evidence.

native_exit.100: completed, mark current catalog game flag
native_exit.102: retry at most3 attempts, then retry-exhausted
native_exit.scope: bookkeeping only, file integrity and session authentication remain unverified

binding.identity: both catalog MD5s, distinct gameOrdinal/referenceOrdinal/regionOrdinal, original Code, PatchEXE declared body, canonical metadata, directory and explicit path encoding; optional Galaxy selection is validated
binding.source: selected PIP/PPort only; BIP is not permission for patch HTTP
binding.missing_source: reject requested patch; no native hardcoded fallback
binding.no_original_process: plan exposes original copy/hidden/wait/delete observations but executes none

iterator.complete: done=true,value contains owned final files and reports only after all operations succeed
iterator.cancel: return() drops pending computation; no partial candidate exposed, no JS heap-erasure guarantee
iterator.sync: applyGamePatchCandidates drives the same generator using unique supplied archives; extra/missing packages remain errors

async.snapshot: configuration and files owned before first await; subsequent caller mutation cannot rebind request or candidate
async.time_profile: explicit nonnegative signed32 seconds; no implicit wall clock
async.deadline: one total monotonic1..60000ms budget, remaining budget passed to every GET and checked after decode
async.HTTP: existing credentials-omit, no-store, no-referrer, redirects-rejected client and explicit origin allowlist; no implicit fallback/retry
async.transport_budgets: manifest fetched with1MiB catalog cap then256KiB grammar cap; each ZIP32MiB, aggregate64MiB through iterator
async.URL_policy: raw path names with ?/#/% or whitespace rejected as unsupported portable transport syntax; no guessed URL encoding
async.result: game-patch-candidate or explicit skip disposition; candidate/requests/binding/processPlan; trust/authentication unverified,replacement/file operations/execution not-performed

retained_v26_policies: strict final MD5, relativeASCII candidate paths, budgets, all ZIP entry CRC and input preservation remain independent policies, not native filesystem rollback.
not_implemented: Browser login-page update UI and candidate persistence/selection
